primary_object.label: building
primary_object.visual_summary: A large, yellow, multi-story building with white trim and columns, featuring a prominent entrance with stairs and a balcony.

style_relevant_features.name: building facade
style_relevant_features.location_hint: the main yellow and white exterior walls of the building
style_relevant_features.line_art_instruction: Outline the main rectangular and square shapes of the facade, including the prominent vertical white columns and horizontal trim. Detail the window frames and the arched recess above the central windows on the second floor. Include the triangular pediments at the top of some sections.

style_relevant_features.name: balcony railing
style_relevant_features.location_hint: the railing on the balcony on the right side of the building
style_relevant_features.line_art_instruction: Draw the intricate pattern of the balcony railing, emphasizing its curves and vertical supports.

style_relevant_features.name: columns at entrance
style_relevant_features.location_hint: the large grey columns supporting the balcony at the main entrance
style_relevant_features.line_art_instruction: Outline the rectangular shape of the columns and the base they stand on. Indicate the steps leading up to the entrance.

style_relevant_features.name: roofline
style_relevant_features.location_hint: the top edges of the building
style_relevant_features.line_art_instruction: Trace the distinct horizontal and angled lines of the roof, including the cornices and any visible overhangs.

style_relevant_features.name: windows
style_relevant_features.location_hint: all visible windows on the building
style_relevant_features.line_art_instruction: Draw simple rectangular outlines for each window, showing their placement and proportion on the facade.

occluders.name: trees
occluders.location_hint: the green trees in front of the building
occluders.mask_prompt: the foliage and trunks of the trees obscuring the building

occluders.name: tree branches
occluders.location_hint: the branches and leaves in the upper right corner

notes_for_generation: Focus on the architectural details of the building. The trees should be rendered as occluders, not as part of the primary object. Ensure the lines are clean and represent the geometric forms of the architecture.
